acceptance.criterion: Working branch + dedicated worktree created per preflight; `verify_repo.py --ci` and the consistency checker green at the starting tip (recorded in the execution log).

Upstream reference recorded: `PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent` cloned shallow to a scratch path for consultation, its HEAD SHA recorded in the execution log and reused verbatim in the B7 CHANGELOG attribution line. No files copied from the clone into the repo.
Session staged with this plan's acceptance mapping (`acceptance_contract.py validate` + `sync-session --write` clean).

Fingerprint determinism proven by tests: touch-only (mtime) changes produce an identical fingerprint; content, untracked, and symlink changes produce a different one; `.elves/runtime/` churn is invisible to it.
Capture failure and over-cap trees classify as `changed` (test-pinned), never futile; transient-failure retries remain budget-exempt (existing tests still green).

Full-run simulation fixture: substantive failure → unchanged tree → next candidate classified `redrive_futile:workspace_unchanged`, one budget unit consumed, no identical packet relaunch, escalation recorded in events and the execution log.
Gap-packet fixture contains the mandatory delta line in both changed and unchanged variants; behavior-policy scenario fixtures updated and green.
Existing re-drive, labor-completeness, and monitor tests pass unchanged except where assertions were extended for the new classification (regression preservation).
Round-trip property test: propose → apply → rollback restores a byte-identical `learnings.md`; history contains both rows with correct before/after.
Digest is bounded (per-line and total caps test-pinned), deterministic, and regenerated only inside its markers — surrounding freehand content byte-preserved.
Legacy tolerance: an id-less `learnings.md` passes `validate`, is readable everywhere it is read today, and ledger edit verbs refuse with a `migrate` hint instead of rewriting it.
Concurrent-freehand safety: a file modified between parse and apply is re-parsed; unparseable input refuses without modifying the file (test-pinned).
History sidecar enforces caps and atomic append (flock contention test), matching the calibration-store idiom.
Fixture streams for each `reports_usage` transport aggregate to correct totals; a transport without usage yields literal `unobserved` completeness (never zero) — test-pinned.
Ceiling crossing produces a checkpoint event and notification and does not stop, park differently, or alter routing (fixture proves identical route decisions with and without the ledger).
Cache-read exclusion from ceiling comparison test-pinned; docs state observed ≠ billed.
Calibration store: old rows read cleanly; new rows with the usage field round-trip; caps and idempotence tests still green (regression preservation).
Elves Report fixture renders the usage panel when data exists and omits it cleanly when everything is `unobserved`.
Simulated worker death yields the salvage block in wake context and gap packet; clean completion yields none (fixtures for both).
Redaction parity: salvage output passes the same synthetic secret-corpus tests as existing redaction surfaces (shell and Python corpora).
Size caps enforced; binary/malformed logs tolerated without error; salvage text is marked untrusted and never parsed as a completion report (test-pinned).
Existing worker-failure classification and re-drive tests pass unchanged (regression preservation).
Every added normative sentence has its pin; consistency checker green.
Wording appears on all surfaces that restate the affected contracts (SKILL.md, relevant references, guide) with no contradictions introduced.
Docs-only diff: no behavior or code change in this batch (verified by test suite passing untouched).
Single-flight proven: concurrent watchdog invocations against one run yield exactly one resume attempt (contention test).

Terminal-refuse honored end-to-end: a fixture run whose event log contains `run_complete` (and one with an unverifiable log) is never resumed and its state, events, and report are byte-for-byte unchanged after a watchdog pass.
`install|status|remove` idempotent with dry-run template-generation tests on both platforms (no root, OS interaction mocked); nothing is installed by default anywhere in the suite or install flow.
Revised scheduler pin present; old pin wording absent; consistency checker green.
Authority boundary test: the watchdog code path cannot reach merge, authorization, or readiness state (no imports/calls into landing authority; test-pinned).
CHANGELOG v2.24.0 entry naming each shipped mechanism and the upstream attribution (repo URL + SHA from B0-A2); version strings bumped wherever `release_checklist.py` requires.
`verify_repo.py --ci`, `--final-readiness`, and the consistency checker green at the exact tip; public-API snapshot reconciled (approvals only for intentional additions).
Dual review per house convention (Fugu review + independent agent) with every blocker consolidated, revised, and delta re-reviewed; landable PR with green CI.
Operational-artifact cleanup commit and post-cleanup tip attestation per the canonical landing sequence; user-owned merge decision.

Learnings round-trip proof: apply → digest → rollback restores byte-identical `learnings.md`; history complete; legacy id-less files fully tolerated.

Usage honesty proof: fixture streams surface into session block, Session Budget, and report; `unobserved` never becomes a number; ceiling crossing checkpoints without stopping; routing decisions provably unaffected.
Salvage proof: simulated worker death produces redacted, untrusted salvage in wake context and gap packet; secret-corpus parity green.
Continuity proof: single-flight, terminal-refuse byte-identity, idempotent install/status/remove, default-off everywhere.

Whole-repo coherence: all new terms in the glossary, all restated sentences pinned, consistency + CI + final-readiness green, CHANGELOG/version/attribution complete, reviewed landable PR at the attested tip.
